021
022public class MercsOnTheRun extends HubMissionWithBarEvent {
023        public static float BASE_PRICE_MULT = 0.75f;
024        
025        protected FleetMemberAPI member;
026        protected int price;
027        protected int quantity;
028        protected MarketAPI market;
029        protected String commodity;
030        protected int totalPrice;
031        
032        @Override
033        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
034                
035                if (barEvent) {
036                        setGiverFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
037                        setGiverPost(Ranks.POST_MARINE_SQUAD_LEADER);
038                        setGiverVoice(Voices.SPACER);
039                        setGiverImportance(pickLowImportance());
040                        //no. setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD, Tags.CONTACT_TRADE);
041                        findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
042                }
043                
044                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
045                if (person == null) return false;
046                
047                market = person.getMarket();
048                if (market == null) return false;
049                
050                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$motr_ref")) {
051                        return false;
052                }
053        
054                commodity = "marines"; // kosher?
055        
056                quantity = 30 + genRandom.nextInt(21);
057                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
058                        quantity /= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_marinesPriceMult");
059                        quantity = (int) quantity;
060                        if (quantity < 3) quantity = 3;
061                        //quantity = 5 + genRandom.nextInt(6);
062                }
063                
064                float _price = market.getSupplyPrice(commodity, 1, true);
065                
066                float unitPrice = (int) (_price * BASE_PRICE_MULT);
067                if (unitPrice > 50) {
068                        unitPrice = unitPrice / 10 * 10;
069                }
070                if (unitPrice < 1 && unitPrice > 0) {
071                        unitPrice = 1;
072                }
073                
074                price = (int)(unitPrice * quantity);
075                
076                setRepFactionChangesTiny();
077                setRepPersonChangesVeryLow();
078                
079                return true;
080        }
081        
082        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
083                // this is weird - in the accept() method, the mission is aborted, which unsets
084                // $hmdf_ref. So: we use $hmdf_ref2 in the ContactPostAccept rule
085                // and $hmdf_ref2 has an expiration of 0, so it'll get unset on its own later.
086                set("$motr_ref2", this);
087                
088                set("$motr_barEvent", isBarEvent());
089                set("$motr_price", price);
090                set("$motr_numberOfMarines", quantity);
091                set("$motr_priceText", Misc.getWithDGS(price));
092                set("$motr_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
093                set("$motr_hisOrHer", getPerson().getHisOrHer());
094                set("$motr_member", member);
095        }
096        
097        @Override
098        protected boolean callAction(String action, String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
099                //if ("showShip".equals(action)) {
100                //      dialog.getVisualPanel().showFleetMemberInfo(member, true);
101                //      return true;
102                if ("buyMarines".equals(action)) {
103                        //dialog.getVisualPanel().showPersonInfo(getPerson(), true);
104                        PlayerFleetPersonnelTracker.getInstance().update();
105                        PlayerFleetPersonnelTracker.getInstance().getMarineData().addXP((float)quantity);
106                        return true;
107                }
108                return false;
109        }
110
111        @Override
112        public String getBaseName() {
113                return "Mercs On The Run"; // not used I don't think
114        }
115        
116        @Override
117        public void accept(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
118                // it's just an transaction immediate transaction handled in rules.csv
119                // no intel item etc
120                
121                currentStage = new Object(); // so that the abort() assumes the mission was successful
122                abort();
123                
124                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : getPerson().getMarket().getContainingLocation().getFleets()) {
125                        if (fleet.getFaction().isPlayerFaction()) continue;
126                        if (!Misc.isPatrol(fleet)) continue;
127                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.PATROL_EXTRA_SUSPICION, 1f);
128                }
129        }
130        
131}
